description: Product and supplier records from Made-in-China.com with price tiers, MOQ, specifications, supplier firmographics, audit metadata, contact page fields, and a computed lead score.

results.description: Dataset containing product records (searchProducts, categoryBrowse, productDetails, supplierProducts) and supplier records (searchSuppliers, supplierDetails). Product rows include legacy title/price/minOrder plus numeric priceMin/priceMax, priceTiers, minOrderQuantity, specifications, images, video, categories, FAQ, supplier profile, audit data, and leadScore. Supplier rows include legacy supplier/products/certifications plus firmographics, trade terms, membership, audit report, contact page fields, product groups, verified fields, and leadScore.
results.title: Made-in-China results
